name: mori
description: Persistent, cross-device memory for your AI coding agents — self-hosted and AGPL, so your knowledge never leaves your own infrastructure. Connect to a Mori server you run; every session distils into durable, searchable memory, so agents start informed, not cold. /brief loads context, /pensieve searches it.

server_url.title: Mori server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the mori-advisor server you run — enter the address where it is reachable from this machine, e.g. http://localhost:8968 (local) or http://100.x.y.z:8968 (LAN/Tailscale). No default: if you run mori on another host, set its URL here or the plugin cannot connect.

api_key.title: Mori API key
api_key.description: Your named API key (name:secret). Optional if the server is unauthenticated.
